## Review Findings (Full Payload)

_Per-finding payload for plan-review accepted, plan-review rejected, and code-review rejected entries. Existing tally tables in `plan-review-tally` and `code-review-tally` are unchanged. The accepted code-review payload is currently not captured in this format — see follow-up issue._

### REJ_C1 — generic
- **Phase**: code-review
- **Outcome**: rejected
- **Reviewer**: Codex (round 1)
- **Category**: generic
- **Prose body** (verbatim from source artifact):

> **Finding**: Pre-rendered body files in `render-specialist-prompt.sh` are selected by basename only, so any `--agent-file /tmp/reviewer-structure.md` with different content would silently use the pre-rendered body from `agents/pre-rendered/reviewer-structure-body.txt` instead.
> **Reason not implemented**: By design. Pre-rendered bodies represent the canonical reviewer personality for the current plugin version. The call site (launch-review.sh) always passes `agents/reviewer-*.md` paths. The test explicitly verifies the pre-rendered body takes precedence, which is intentional behavior.

### REJ_C2 — generic
- **Phase**: code-review
- **Outcome**: rejected
- **Reviewer**: Codex (round 1) — OOS
- **Category**: generic
- **Prose body** (verbatim from source artifact):

> **Finding**: `skills/implement/SKILL.md:1445` — `CHANGED_COUNT=$(... | grep -c . || echo 0)` produces two lines.
> **Reason not implemented**: Out of scope — `skills/implement/SKILL.md` was not modified in this PR.
